author: Serena Fuller
content:
I hired a soft play package from dancing cubs over the weekend 21st Jan 18 quite last minute and they were absolutely brilliant! They responded promptly and confirmed my booking.

As promised two member's came on time and set up in our venue. They even offered if they could help me bring in some of the things for the party. They go above and beyond!

Ill definitely be using them again and would recommend their services!!

Thanks guys!!
